# Bluetick — WhatsApp Marketing & Automation Platform

Bluetick is an AI-powered WhatsApp Business API SaaS platform that enables
businesses to run bulk campaigns, automate chatbot flows, manage contacts,
sell products via an integrated online store, and share digital business cards (vCards).

## Core Features

- Bulk WhatsApp messaging and campaign broadcasts
- AI-powered chatbot flow builder (drag-and-drop, no code)
- WhatsApp Business API integration (Meta Cloud API)
- CRM with contact management, labeling, and segmentation
- Online store with WhatsApp-native checkout and UPI/card payments
- Digital business cards (vCards) with NFC support
- Click-to-WhatsApp (CTWA) Meta Ads integration
- Team inbox and live chat
- Multi-language support
